rule: Each feature has one recommended production path and a documented fallback that preserves the buyer journey.

features.recommended: Existing model-viewer/GLB showroom engine with project-specific camera and hotspots.
features.fallback: Matched poster plus HTML hotspot layer using the same unit IDs.
features.avoid: A black loading canvas or a decorative model without selectable units.

features.recommended: One unit collection in window.NADLAN_SHOWROOM and WordPress project_3d_units_json.
features.fallback: Server-rendered unit cards populated from the same JSON.
features.avoid: Separate manual hotspot and card datasets.

features.recommended: Inline stage panel linked by plan_id, with zoom, share and studio handoff.
features.fallback: Accessible modal using CSS target or dialog with focus return.
features.avoid: Opening an unrelated image or losing the selected unit.

features.recommended: Mapbox map, project marker and direction beam driven by unit azimuth plus floor-aware panorama.
features.fallback: Static georeferenced map image and calculated beam overlay.
features.avoid: A generic scenic image that does not change with direction.

features.recommended: Project-owned 2:1 panorama endpoint with room hotspots and unit context.
features.fallback: Interactive room gallery preserving unit ID.
features.avoid: A single PNG presented as a tour.

features.recommended: Selectable facility hotspots with image, level, description, operation and accessibility.
features.fallback: Horizontal facility cards using the same facility collection.

features.recommended: Shared project coordinates across every Mapbox/Cesium view and categorized POIs.
features.fallback: Static map with explicit point coordinates and walking times.
features.avoid: Different project markers in different modules.

features.recommended: Existing studio.js fed by selected unit, plan and BOM option groups.
features.fallback: Step wizard producing the same RFP payload.
features.avoid: Selections without quantities, codes or unit context.

features.recommended: Existing /wp-json/nadlan/v1/lead and /brochure endpoints with project and unit context.
features.fallback: WordPress form handler using the same payload contract.
features.avoid: A generic contact form that discards the apartment choice.

features.recommended: Existing ?cotour=host|join&room= contract with synchronized unit and scene state.
features.fallback: Share link preserving project, unit and scene.

features.recommended: Nonblocking meta box fed by machine results and manual evidence.
features.fallback: Standalone Recipe Lab report imported as JSON.
features.avoid: A publish blocker or one opaque score.

features.recommended: Server-side fetch of the public URL, immutable snapshot and diff.
features.fallback: Manual saved View Source HTML attached to the project record.
features.avoid: Treating the WordPress editor DOM as public source evidence.
